amendments.reason: Read-only GPT-6.2 Sol pinyin review of all 4,354 legacy sentences (212 findings), each checked in context; accepted fixes include polyphones (长 cháng/zhǎng, 种 zhòng, 都 dōu, 教 jiāo, 场 chǎng, 为 wéi/wèi, 调 tiáo, 系 jì, 挨 ái …), copula 是 shì, neutral 不 in potential complements, reduplicated-verb neutral tones, required neutral tones (学问, 队伍, 痛快, 老婆, 徒弟 …), erhua 儿 r, and 一个/每个/那个 个 ge for consistency. Chinese text, segmentation, glosses and audio unchanged. Checked against the official GF0025-2021 word list afterwards: 痛快 tòng kuài and 徒弟 tú dì keep their tones (optional neutral tone), 事实上 shì shí shang and 码头 mǎ tóu follow the official notation.

amendments.reason: 谁 written shéi throughout. GF0025-2021 lists 谁 shéi / shuí (shéi first); the two readings carry no difference in meaning or usage, and the data had mixed them by tool source rather than by context. Also applied to the 7-9 band. Chinese text, segmentation, glosses and audio unchanged.

Cross-check of all 4,354 legacy sentences against PinyinJS, pinyin-pro and g2pW; every disagreement judged in context. Two readings fixed: 切菜 qiē (to cut) and 胡子长了 zhǎng (to grow). Chinese text, segmentation, glosses and audio unchanged.

Measure word 场 written chǎng throughout, following GF0025-2021, which lists only 场 chǎng (the dictionary split cháng for the course of events / chǎng for performances is no longer applied). Also applied to the 7-9 band. Chinese text, segmentation, glosses and audio unchanged.

Two legacy sentences re-synthesized after listening: 为难 in hsk5-0178 was misread (should be wéi nán) and the final 斗 in hsk4-0420 was unclear. Seed 45 chosen by the maintainer; CosyVoice2 at speed 1.0, slow = same PCM + ffmpeg atempo=0.8 (the method used for the 7-9 band), so audio_meta now records the slow method. Text, pinyin, segmentation and glosses unchanged.

Legacy pinyin_numbered had been generated by pypinyin directly, so it diverged from the reviewed toned pinyin in 100 records: 99 wrote erhua as a separate r5 syllable (na3 r5 instead of nar3) and hsk1-0062 had 中文 as zhong4. pinyin_numbered is now derived from the toned pinyin for every level, as for the 7-9 band. Toned pinyin, tokens, text and audio unchanged. Separately, the 11 reduplicated-verb sentences (看看, 走走, 试试 ...) now carry positional token_pinyin overrides (e.g. 看#2: kan) in the YAML sources so a rebuild keeps their neutral second syllable; their published records were already correct and are unchanged.
